args: import json,sys; from django.contrib.auth.models import User,Permission; from django.db.models import Q; from rest_framework.authtoken.models import Token; from paperless.version import __full_version_str__; d=json.load(sys.stdin); u=User.objects.create_user(username=d['username'],password=d['password']); u.user_permissions.set(Permission.objects.filter(Q(codename__startswith='view_')|Q(content_type__app_label='documents',content_type__model__in=['correspondent','documenttype','tag','uisettings']))); t=Token.objects.create(user=u); print('STUDY_AUTH='+json.dumps({'username':u.username,'user_id':u.id,'token':t.key,'password':d['password'],'version':__full_version_str__,'is_staff':u.is_staff,'is_superuser':u.is_superuser}))
